1.web: God, the nations have come into your inheritance. They have defiled your holy temple. They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.
1.asv: O God, the nations are come into thine inheritance; Thy holy temple have they defiled; They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.

2.web: They have given the dead bodies of your servants to be food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of your saints to the animals of the earth.
2.asv: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be food unto the birds of the heavens, The flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.

3.web: Their blood they have shed like water around Jerusalem. There was no one to bury them.
3.asv: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem; And there was none to bury them.

4.web: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and derision to those who are around us.
4.asv: We are become a reproach to our neighbors, A scoffing and derision to them that are round about us.

5.web: How long, Yahweh? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?
5.asv: How long, O Jehovah? wilt thou be angry for ever? Shall thy jealousy burn like fire?

6.web: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you; on the kingdoms that don’t call on your name;
6.asv: Pour out thy wrath upon the nations that know thee not, And upon the kingdoms that call not upon thy name.

7.web: For they have devoured Jacob, and destroyed his homeland.
7.asv: For they have devoured Jacob, And laid waste his habitation.

8.web: Don’t hold the iniquities of our forefathers against us. Let your tender mercies speedily meet us, for we are in desperate need.
8.asv: Remember not against us the iniquities of our forefathers: Let thy tender mercies speedily meet us; For we are brought very low.

9.web: Help us, God of our salvation, for the glory of your name. Deliver us, and forgive our sins, for your name’s sake.
9.asv: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of thy name; And deliver us, and forgive our sins, for thy name’s sake.

10.web: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?” Let it be known among the nations, before our eyes, that vengeance for your servants’ blood is being poured out.
10.asv: Wherefore should the nations say, Where is their God? Let the avenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed Be known among the nations in our sight.

11.web: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before you. According to the greatness of your power, preserve those who are sentenced to death.
11.asv: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee: According to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to death;

12.web: Pay back to our neighbors seven times into their bosom their reproach with which they have reproached you, Lord.
12.asv: And render unto our neighbors sevenfold into their bosom Their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.

13.web: So we, your people and sheep of your pasture, will give you thanks forever. We will praise you forever, to all generations.
13.asv: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture Will give thee thanks for ever: We will show forth thy praise to all generations.
